The '''Sand Pirate Base''' was a bunker located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and used by a criminal group known as the [[Sand Pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The bunker served as the base for the Sand Pirates. It was located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Tatooine, atop a hilly area a short distance north of [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], overlooking the [[City/Legends|city]]. The interior of the base was decorated with a number of items, including a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] of a Tatooinian town, and [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] trophies of a [[Bane Back spider]] and [[painted spat]].<ref name="SWG:FD" />

==History==
{{Quote|You go to their base, kill their leader, and make sure that no one will be able to use the base again.|[[Coris Mao]], to a commando|<ref name="SWG:FD" />}}
[[File:SandPirateBaseInterior.jpg|220px|thumb|The lowest level of the Sand Pirate Base.]]
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Sand Pirates used to attack any [[Transport/Legends|transport]] which found itself close to their base.<ref name="SWG:FD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the pirates caused many troubles to local [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] and interfered with the activities of [[Coris Mao]]'s business partners. Mao finally contacted [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Snopel]],<ref name="SWG:FD" /> a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]],<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Commando|Commando|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> in order to got rid of the pirates. Snopel therefore dispatched a group of commandos under training to deal with the pirates. The commandos [[Death/Legends|killed]] the two guards at the base's entrance, and eliminated at least ten others within the bunker's confines in order to send a message that innocent citizens could not be [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorized]] with impunity. At the base's lowest level, the soldiers encountered and killed the boss of the Sand Pirates. Eventually, the commandos overloaded the reactor of the base, thereby blowing up the building. The raid disrupted the activities of the Sand Pirates for the time being.<ref name="SWG:FD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sand Pirate Base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sand Pirate Base was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
